criteria.requirement: With XY blend zero, preset output is bit-exact unchanged.
With XY blend one, output is xyOutput and independent of preset output.
check: two distinct preset values and exact formula

criteria.requirement: Intermediate blend is a bounded linear preset-to-XY crossfade.
check: sampled blend sweep, finite and no overshoot

criteria.requirement: Preset OFF retains the existing XY-only warm-up and ramp behavior.
Depth zero is bit-exact dry and bypass keeps XY blend zero.
Saved trajectory playback receives the same XY-priority routing as live input.
Hold remains XY-active and does not restore the preset until XY becomes inactive.
Missing PCM, warm-up, and input-silence end return to the preset path.
Changing a preset cannot change fully-active XY output.
Preset DSP continues to process internally and resumes through the existing blend without reset.
Stereo channels remain independent, finite, and free of abnormal crossfade peaks.
No allocation, lock, ValueTree access, I/O, or logging is added to the audio thread.
check: code review and existing realtime regression

criteria.requirement: Y remains audio-neutral and no UI, State, parameter, latency, or preset algorithm changes occur.
check: diff allowlist and existing XY regressions

criteria.requirement: The focused XY deterministic test passes.
The unconfirmed boon sound is not falsely claimed fixed; XY-only and prior parallel mix are separately measurable.
A D manual-test bundle is provenance-bound to its CI artifact and is not promoted to candidate.
